verdict: COHR surges 7%+ on NVIDIA $2B commitment; CRDO -18% on margin miss; SNDK joins S&P 100; MU pre-earnings; DRAM QoQ decelerating but HBM thesis intact — mixed/bullish tone.
body_md:
## Fresh Developments (Last 24–72 h)

**COHR — ECOC 2026 platform + NVIDIA investment (Sept 20):** Coherent unveiled the PhotonLink integrated-optics platform (CPO/NPO/chip-to-chip), a 3.2T OSFP pluggable, and a 2.3 Tbit/s VCSEL array at ECOC in Malaga. Same day, NVIDIA committed an additional **$2B investment** in Coherent with a multibillion-dollar InP optical engine purchase agreement (separate from the March 2026 $4B multi-supplier deal). COHR +7%+. **Most important development of the week.**

**SNDK — S&P 100 inclusion (effective Sept 21):** SanDisk added to the S&P 100 alongside Dell, PANW, and ANET. Stock +7.39% on Sept 18 on the announcement + upbeat demand commentary. Also announced a **$14B buyback**. Passive index rebalancing inflows active this week.

**CRDO — Fiscal Q1 miss, -17.9% (Sept 19–20):** Gross margin compressed to 64.5% from 68.2% QoQ; opex also rose. Meaningful underperformance vs. the premium-margin thesis the stock was priced for.

**ZS — Q4 FY2026 beat (mid-Sept):** EPS $1.19 vs. $1.09 est.; revenue $898M vs. $877M est. Current-quarter guide also beat. No unusual catalyst — execution in line.

**MU — Pre-earnings, Sept 30:** Q3 FY2026 already beat $20.20 EPS est. by 24% ($25.11). Consensus for fiscal year-end Sept 30 print: $50.8B revenue / $31.35 EPS. Stock trading $978–$1,019 intraday Sept 20; YTD +256%.

**Amazon-Qualcomm custom chip deal (Sept 8 — just outside window):** ~$60B 10-year commitment for custom AI silicon. Bearish NVDA/AWS share on a 5-yr view; incrementally dilutive to pure-NVDA datacenter dependency narrative.

---

## Context (vs. Baseline)

- **DRAM decel, HBM intact:** Server DRAM QoQ now +13–18% in Q3 vs. the +90–95% Q1 blowout — high-base normalization, not demand destruction. HBM3E spot ~$300/stack, HBM4 ~$550/stack; 2026 capacity fully allocated. 2027 forward curve still bullish per TrendForce (June 2). **No correction signal yet** but baseline warned of post-2026 correction risk — watch Q4 prints.
- **Hyperscaler capex:** Combined Big-4 tracking ~$725B for 2026 (+77% YoY), above baseline $600–700B. Alphabet raised ceiling to $175–205B. No new Q3 guidance in the Sept 19-21 window; next catalyst is Q3 earnings (October).
- **Optical thesis pull-forward:** NVIDIA-COHR deepened commitment reinforces COHR over LITE in the CPO horse race. CPO production (Spectrum-X) since May 2026; real volume still 2027-2028 per TrendForce. COHR's PhotonLink is the vertical-integration defense play.
- **Custom silicon:** Meta MTIA v4 sampling with HBM4 (late 2026) — first MTIA with HBM, signals training ambition. AMD MI455X/Helios launched July 2026; shipments ramping into 2027.
- **Solar:** Section 232 polysilicon tariffs signed Aug 7, effective Dec 4, 2026. MIP floors: $0.22/W cells, $0.38/W modules. Creates a ~10-week pull-forward procurement window now underway. FSLR domestic moat widens.

---

## Most Important Development

**COHR +7% on NVIDIA's $2B incremental investment commitment (Sept 20):** This is a second large capital-deployment signal from NVIDIA toward Coherent in six months, deepening the sole-source InP optical engine relationship. It structurally widens COHR's moat in CPO/photonics and reduces supply diversification risk to LITE/competitors near-term. Combined with the PhotonLink CPO platform reveal at ECOC, this is the clearest 'named by NVIDIA' watchlist event of the week.
